toolDefinitions.name: events-list
toolDefinitions.description: List what is on the calendar between two days, repeats included, in time order. With no arguments: today and the next six days. The answer also gives today's date and the zone, so use it to resolve words like Thursday.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, included. At most 400 days from from.

zone.description: IANA zone for the day boundaries. Default: the zone set on the add-on page.

toolDefinitions.name: events-search
toolDefinitions.description: Find events by words in the title, notes, place or attendees. Every word must match. Gives each event once, with the start of its next occurrence.

toolDefinitions.name: event-get
toolDefinitions.description: Read one event in full, with the dates taken out of a repeat.

toolDefinitions.name: event-create
toolDefinitions.description: Add an event to the calendar at once. Needs a title and a start. Give the local time the person said and leave zone out unless they named another place.

title.description: What the event is, for example Dinner with Sam.

start.description: Local start: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event.

end.description: Local end, same shape as start. For an all-day event it is the last day. Default: one hour after start.

allDay.description: True for an event that lasts whole days.

zone.description: IANA zone name of start and end, such as Europe/Rome. Default: the zone set on the add-on page.

place.description: Where it takes place, free text.

attendees.description: Who comes, free text, such as Sam and Lea.

repeat.description: How the event comes again. freq daily, weekly, monthly or yearly; interval counts days, weeks, months or years (default 1); until is the last day, YYYY-MM-DD. freq none takes the repeat away.

toolDefinitions.name: event-update
toolDefinitions.description: Change an event. Name only what changes. On a repeating event it changes the whole series; to drop one day use event-delete with occurrence.

id.description: The event ID from events-list or event-get.

title.description: What the event is, for example Dinner with Sam.

start.description: Local start: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event.

end.description: Local end, same shape as start. For an all-day event it is the last day. Default: one hour after start.

allDay.description: True for an event that lasts whole days.

zone.description: IANA zone name of start and end, such as Europe/Rome. Default: the zone set on the add-on page.

place.description: Where it takes place, free text.

attendees.description: Who comes, free text, such as Sam and Lea.

repeat.description: How the event comes again. freq daily, weekly, monthly or yearly; interval counts days, weeks, months or years (default 1); until is the last day, YYYY-MM-DD. freq none takes the repeat away.

toolDefinitions.name: event-delete
toolDefinitions.description: Delete an event. For a repeating event, give occurrence (the date of one occurrence, YYYY-MM-DD) to skip only that day, or leave it out to delete the whole series.

occurrence.description: Date of the one occurrence to skip, YYYY-MM-DD.

toolDefinitions.name: settings-get
toolDefinitions.description: Read the default zone of the calendar. For the add-on page.

toolDefinitions.name: settings-set
toolDefinitions.description: Set the default zone of the calendar. For the add-on page; no model calls it.

description.en: Your agents read and keep your calendar: what is on Thursday, dinner at 8, a weekly repeat. It lives inside LocalAI, with no account to connect.
description.it: I tuoi agenti leggono e tengono il tuo calendario: cosa c'è giovedì, una cena alle 8, una ripetizione settimanale. Vive dentro LocalAI, senza nessun account da collegare.
description.de: Ihre Agenten lesen und führen Ihren Kalender: was am Donnerstag ansteht, Abendessen um 8, eine wöchentliche Wiederholung. Er lebt in LocalAI, ohne Konto, das verbunden werden muss.
description.es: Tus agentes leen y llevan tu calendario: qué hay el jueves, una cena a las 8, una repetición semanal. Vive dentro de LocalAI, sin ninguna cuenta que conectar.
description.fr: Vos agents lisent et tiennent votre agenda : ce qui est prévu jeudi, un dîner à 20 h, une répétition hebdomadaire. Il vit dans LocalAI, sans compte à connecter.
description.pt-BR: Seus agentes leem e mantêm sua agenda: o que há na quinta, um jantar às 8, uma repetição semanal. Ela vive dentro do LocalAI, sem nenhuma conta para conectar.
description.zh-CN: 你的智能体可以查看并维护你的日历：周四有什么安排、晚上 8 点的晚餐、每周重复的事项。日历保存在 LocalAI 内部，无需连接任何账户。
description.ko: 에이전트가 일정을 읽고 관리합니다. 목요일 일정, 8시 저녁 식사, 매주 반복되는 일정까지. 일정은 LocalAI 안에 저장되며 연결할 계정이 필요 없습니다.
description.id: Agen Anda membaca dan mengelola kalender Anda: apa yang ada hari Kamis, makan malam jam 8, pengulangan mingguan. Kalender ini tersimpan di dalam LocalAI, tanpa akun yang perlu dihubungkan.
